name: Kraków Open 2013

venue.name: [Wydzial Fizyki, Matematyki i Informatyki Politechniki Krakowskiej](http://www.fmi.pk.edu.pl)

information: Registration fee is 15 PLN. Limit of competitors is 60. Registration starts 28th April and ends 10th May. Registration fee must be paid before 12th May on bank account or by PayPal (more information on Competition website). If someone resign he may request of refunding registration fee, but only before 12th May.
